capture.clock: time.monotonic() arm clock; seal = accepted-final arrival wall on same clock; pending requests may attach future words up to seal
capture.flush_rule: Existing send_audio queue-put is NOT flush. Experiment-local tee/wrapper records actual websocket audio-send completion per chunk: source sample range, scheduled target wall, enqueue wall, flush start/end walls, byte kind (audio/trailing/finalize/keepalive). Open offset recorded. Raw provider messages with arrival walls, final markers, and consumer accepted final preserved.
capture.frontier_semantics: Source evidence acquisition frontier is at minimum sample receipt to inference; socket ASR flush recorded separately; never assumed same. Out-of-payload support frontier cannot be measured and stays UNKNOWN (schedule never extrapolated as actual).
capture.journal: Crash-safe attempt journal (captures/attempt_journal.jsonl) appended BEFORE a session opens; failed attempts retained, never deleted. Budget guard refuses a 4th provider session.
capture.key: SONIOX_API_KEY from .env.local, process-only; never written to outputs
capture.model: stt-rt-v5 via existing provider adapter path; experiment-local instrumentation only, production code untouched
capture.pacing: realtime 32ms paced pump; trailing 100ms silence; exactly one finalize; no hold / pre-roll / split
capture.same_stream: All arms consume the SAME captured stream per case
capture.secrets: No raw keys in any receipt

arms: control (correct-transition: GT b+100ms; compute timing unknown unless actually measured)

availability.confirmation_support: control charges annotation-supported boundary + 100ms (1600-sample) confirmation support; actual model/event compute lag UNKNOWN (never zero)
availability.deadline: text-ownership seal = accepted-final arrival wall on the same measured session clock; identical provider/text/policy/frontier across arms
availability.definition: availability = measured flush wall of frontier sample + unknown nonnegative model/event lag L >= 0
availability.max_permissible_lag: deadline_wall - flush_wall(frontier_sample), reported exactly per timed-text case/arm. Negative => too_late even at zero lag. Nonnegative => conditional receipt only (UNKNOWN lag, never causal PASS on lower bound alone)

evidence_policy.conservation: Accepted-token IDs and exact text derived from the independent accepted records and compared across arms by ID multiplicity and exact text; DROP/DUP negative controls prove detection; conservation is distinct from ownership accuracy
evidence_policy.gt_match: Consumer ASR groups aligned to GT window words monotonically on normalized lexical form plus provider time support; unique alignments only; repeated-word ambiguity stays UNSCORED (enumerated, never greedily assigned); text conservation never equated with owner accuracy; denominators report matched/unmatched/mixed
evidence_policy.join: Join NPZ arrays with original session masks (valid/masked/speech/frontiers/starts/ends) via load_validated_export session join; never assume validity; never relabel overlap as singleton
evidence_policy.method: frontier_sweep.simulate_episode first-event per FULL episode over full session; window filter: requested boundary must fall in the scored span; full prior first event recorded with in-span flag and suppression note (no evidence-absent conflation); no rearming, no threshold tuning
evidence_policy.references: Actual stored references are GT-derived / oracle-mapped; never reinterpret as causal re-enrollment; full prior first event and unsupported scope recorded instead of evidence-absent conflation
evidence_policy.scored_set: The frozen 8-word GT window per case (4 left + 4 right, non-punc) is scored in FULL (all 8; never a favorable subset). in_span flags locate the diagnostic scored span. Ownership: word-end <= arm boundary stays left (reference-owned), otherwise right (new/unknown); a word strictly containing an arm boundary stays intact and is flagged uncertain/ambiguous, never split, never discarded
evidence_policy.sensitivity: +-1280 source samples (one native 80ms frame) each direction, predetermined; sensitivity only, never optimized; no winner picking
evidence_policy.word_rule: Whole-word end_sample <= boundary stays left, otherwise right; straddlers intact + uncertain

gate.causal_separate: Causal applicability is a SEPARATE gate requiring a measured full-path valid profile (sibling timing/ receipt via barrier). No causal PASS is claimed on flush bounds alone.
gate.conservation: EXACT conservation on ALL streams (none/F0/H/control/anchor share one captured stream per case)
gate.harm: No severe harm on declared guards: any confidently wrong-owner assignment on a supported singleton span covering >= one content word is SEVERE and fails the gate. Word-proxy limits explicit (proxies quantify semantic wrong-owner and false segmentation, not ASR harms).
gate.overall: Stage2 overall may be negative/unmet; results reported PASSED/FAILED/UNMEASURED separately, positive outcome never guaranteed and no data/capture expansion is permitted to force one
gate.useful_effect: STRICT reduction of wrong-owner words by the H7301 arm versus the none arm on >= 2 new source sessions INCLUDING the cohort-diverse NP3 case, measured on right matched content plus false-moved left words (all 8 scored words per case; never a favorable subset)
